Apolaki Caldera: Hidden Supervolcano Beneath Philippine SeasEast of Luzon in the Philippine Rise (formerly Benham Rise) lies the Apolaki Caldera, Earth's largest at 150 km diameter, surpassing Yellowstone and Toba. Formed by massive eruptions millions of years ago, it reshaped the seafloor. Named after the Filipino god of sun and war, this dormant feature highlights the Philippines' volatile Ring of Fire geology and was discovered in 2019 by geophysicist Jenny Anne Barretto's team using bathymetric mapping.
